entries.label: EXPLICIT NAV INTENT (high confidence; user asked to be routed)
entries.targetBelief: Scout routes intentionally and transparently.
entries.targetBehavior: User trusts explicit route intents and follows suggested actions.
entries.riskPrevented: Perceived randomness that erodes trust in Scout authority.

entries.label: SYNC LOCAL INTENTS (explicit nav, routing explainer, messaging locked)
entries.targetBelief: Scout can answer known navigation and gate-explanation questions immediately.
entries.targetBehavior: User follows clear local UI shortcuts without waiting on server synthesis.
entries.riskPrevented: Avoidable latency or confusion for stable client-only explanations.

entries.label: ASYNC LOCAL INTENT: Profile lookup
entries.targetBelief: Public profile lookup remains discovery-only.
entries.targetBehavior: User opens a visible profile without assuming contact access or platform power.
entries.riskPrevented: Profile visibility being mistaken for contact permission or ungated access.

entries.label: EXPLANATION: "Why isn't this moving yet?"
entries.targetBelief: State transitions are explainable.
entries.targetBehavior: User requests clarification instead of abandoning flow.
entries.riskPrevented: Confusion interpreted as platform unreliability.

entries.label: EXPLANATION: "Why can't I message yet?"
entries.targetBelief: Contact gating is intentional and fair.
entries.targetBehavior: User completes required intent/decision steps before contact.
entries.riskPrevented: Bypass pressure on gated discovery-to-contact pathway.

entries.label: SCOUT ONBOARDING INTENT (fast win)
entries.targetBelief: Onboarding is guided and immediate.
entries.targetBehavior: User takes first eligible action quickly.
entries.riskPrevented: Early-session drop-off due to uncertainty.

entries.label: PROVIDER INTENT A: "I want to offer services here"
entries.targetBelief: Provider pathways are structured and rule-based.
entries.targetBehavior: Provider follows claim-first steps rather than role assumption.
entries.riskPrevented: Role-first misuse that violates claims-first law.

entries.label: PROVIDER INTENT B: "How strong is my presence here?"
entries.targetBelief: Exposure is merit/trust driven, not arbitrary.
entries.targetBehavior: Provider improves trust signals instead of seeking shortcuts.
entries.riskPrevented: Assumption that spend or noise overrides trust/CVS.

entries.label: PROVIDER INTENT C: "Help me run a promotion/deal"
entries.targetBelief: Promotions are eligibility-governed, not pay-to-play.
entries.targetBehavior: Provider aligns promotion requests with trust/relevance gates.
entries.riskPrevented: Perception of lead-selling or exposure-for-payment.

entries.label: COMMUNITY INTENT: "Help me post an announcement/update"
entries.targetBelief: Community memory is governed and purposeful.
entries.targetBehavior: User uses Scout-guided posting path instead of open feed behavior.
entries.riskPrevented: Social-feed expectations that conflict with authority model.

entries.label: COMMUNITY BUILDER INTENT: donation + contribution flow
entries.targetBelief: County contribution and donation actions are intentional and governed.
entries.targetBehavior: User follows Community Builder proposal and county-vault donation paths.
entries.riskPrevented: Ungoverned donation assumptions that bypass county-context intent flow.

entries.label: CONTRACTOR SEARCH INTENT
entries.targetBelief: Discovery resolves through Scout mediation.
entries.targetBehavior: User follows discovery -> Scout -> intent pathway.
entries.riskPrevented: Ungated direct contact assumptions.

entries.label: MARKETPLACE INTENT: search vs post
entries.targetBelief: Marketplace actions are scoped and policy-bound.
entries.targetBehavior: User selects policy-compatible path (search or post).
entries.riskPrevented: Marketplace framing drift into ad-tech behavior.

entries.label: CONTACT SUPPORT INTENT
entries.targetBelief: Support access is reliable and available.
entries.targetBehavior: User escalates via approved support pathways.
entries.riskPrevented: Dead-end frustration in edge or blocked states.

entries.label: FALLBACK: Use existing server flow if no intent matched
entries.targetBelief: Scout remains responsive when local matching is uncertain.
entries.targetBehavior: User continues asking instead of abandoning due to miss.
entries.riskPrevented: Perceived dead-end when local intent classifier misses.

entries.label: Smart synthesis that ENFORCES the execution contract
entries.targetBelief: Scout output follows enforceable contracts.
entries.targetBehavior: Operators trust action payloads for deterministic handling.
entries.riskPrevented: Contract drift producing unsafe or non-actionable outputs.

entries.label: Fallback: take a hard slice if everything is oversized
entries.targetBelief: Scout degrades safely under payload pressure.
entries.targetBehavior: Users still receive bounded responses in heavy contexts.
entries.riskPrevented: Timeouts or null responses interpreted as system failure.

entries.label: SPECIAL HANDLING: Detect intro/overview questions and use comprehensive synthesis
entries.targetBelief: First-time questions receive coherent orientation.
entries.targetBehavior: Users build mental model before taking actions.
entries.riskPrevented: Early confusion that reduces trust in controller outputs.

entries.label: GOVERNOR MODE: Situation-driven intelligence
entries.targetBelief: Governance constraints are active, not decorative.
entries.targetBehavior: System routes by situation and policy instead of role assumptions.
entries.riskPrevented: Authority bypass or misrouting under ambiguous prompts.

entries.label: LAYER RESOLUTION: Use knowledge service 4-layer system
entries.targetBelief: Scout answers are sourced through layered retrieval.
entries.targetBehavior: Operators trust provenance and fallback behavior.
entries.riskPrevented: Opaque sourcing undermining confidence in responses.

entries.label: SMART SYNTHESIS / DETERMINISTIC ROUTING
entries.targetBelief: Routing remains stable across equivalent intents.
entries.targetBehavior: Users repeat successful prompts with consistent outcomes.
entries.riskPrevented: Perceived randomness in action routing.

entries.label: Deterministic early-exit: if user intent maps cleanly to an allowed
entries.targetBelief: Simple intents complete quickly without unnecessary friction.
entries.targetBehavior: User trusts direct, policy-safe outcomes.
entries.riskPrevented: Latency frustration for obvious intents.

entries.label: Brand identity firewall: if the synthesized answer clearly violates
entries.targetBelief: Brand and authority boundaries are actively protected.
entries.targetBehavior: System resists identity drift or off-brand responses.
entries.riskPrevented: Brand confusion and trust erosion from identity violations.

entries.label: Handle auth-required intent
entries.targetBelief: Protected actions require authentication consistently.
entries.targetBehavior: User authenticates before proceeding with gated intents.
entries.riskPrevented: Unauthorized action expectations and gate bypass attempts.

entries.label: Enhanced-v4 confidence fallback contract
entries.targetBelief: Enhanced Scout only answers directly when confidence is high.
entries.targetBehavior: User receives classic Scout continuity when agent-council confidence is uncertain.
entries.riskPrevented: Low-confidence enhanced responses bypassing stable Scout contracts.

entries.label: Scout profile update assistant
entries.targetBelief: Scout can help edit profile details without replacing manual onboarding.
entries.targetBehavior: User asks Scout for a profile change, reviews the drafted update, then explicitly saves it.
entries.riskPrevented: Silent profile mutation, trust-field bypass, or Scout becoming mandatory onboarding.
